messages:
tess (partnerships): Heads-up - our hardware partner (EdgeAccel) is asking the cloud marketplace team for additional security artifacts for a joint listing. They specifically called out firmware SBOM, signed firmware verification process, SOC2 summary, and a brief on third-party pentest scope that includes both cloud control plane and edge firmware. Deadline: marketplace intake wants docs in 4 business days. Can security/legal/eng help assemble? :wave:

mike (security): Edge firmware is a slightly different ask. We have a firmware SBOM generated for their appliance image (Q3 2024) but it's more detailed than our typical app SBOM. We should confirm whether marketplace wants a full SBOM or a redacted supply-chain statement. Also need to know if they require cryptographic verification details (signing keys, chain of custody).

chloe (eng-ml): For the signing process: EdgeAccel uses UEFI Secure Boot + code signing via their private HSM; they publish a verification policy. We can include a short note describing our integration (what we verify on the control plane side) but not their private key material. I'll draft the integration blurb.

evan (legal): Confirming: vendor-supplied SBOMs may contain third-party licensing info and internal supplier names. We need to check EdgeAccel's disclosure permissions. If marketplace asks for raw firmware images, that's definitely covered by vendor terms. I'll reach out to EdgeAccel legal and the pen-test vendor.

marketplace-bot: Marketplace intake created: https://marketplace.cloud/vendor-intake/1771234000 (requested artifacts: SOC2 summary, pen-test exec, firmware SBOM or statement, KMS/HSM attestation, contact for security review).


tess (partnerships): Copy of the marketplace checklist snippet they pasted: 

```
1) SOC2: provide Type II summary and scope period.
2) Pen Test: external pentest summary covering cloud and edge components (redacted accepted).
3) Firmware SBOM or supply-chain statement: indicate if SBOM available; if not, provide attestation and gating policy.
4) Firmware signing: describe verification process and whether customers can verify signatures.
5) KMS/HSM support: detail customer-managed key options for any secrets used in firmware signing or device auth.
6) Open critical/major vulns in last 90 days.
7) Security contact and availability for a technical review call.
```

mike (security): Proposed answers: SOC2: we have a company SOC2 Type II for Jan-Dec 2024 covering hosted API + infra; attach exec summary. Pen test: third-party pen-test (Nov 2024) covered control plane + console; recommend providing redacted exec which includes CVE IDs, severities, and remediation status. For firmware-specific tests, EdgeAccel ran a hardware/firmware assessment (Oct 2024) by a separate vendor; we can request a redacted summary from them.

chloe (eng-ml): For the SBOM: EdgeAccel provided a bill-of-materials for the firmware image. We should offer either (a) a redacted SBOM that omits internal supplier PII, or (b) a signed attestation from EdgeAccel stating they maintain an SBOM and follow weekly SCA scans. Which does legal prefer?

evan (legal): Ask EdgeAccel for a redacted SBOM plus an attestation letter. If marketplace needs more, we'll route to an NDA-gated review. Also confirm whether the pen-test vendor permits us to share their engagement name and summary; if not, note that and offer gated review.

marketplace-bot: Note: marketplace reviewers sometimes request to see verification steps. Suggest including a short step-by-step: how a customer can validate firmware signature and where to find verification keys.

mike (security): Good point. Chloe, can you draft a 3-step verification guide: 1) pull device manifest, 2) verify signature against published keyset, 3) compare hash to published release? Keep it non-sensitive.

chloe (eng-ml): Yep. I'll draft an ops-friendly 3-step snippet and a short note about attestation endpoints we expose.

tess (partnerships): Plan: mike to prepare SOC2 exec summary + redacted control-plane pen-test highlight; chloe to prepare firmware SBOM statement + signature verification steps; evan to confirm vendor sharing permissions and NDA routing. Target: compile packet 3 business days from now and upload to the marketplace intake URL.

mike (security): I'll also include a short statement: "No open criticals in production in the last 90 days; two high findings in pre-prod were remediated (CH-2510)."

evan (legal): Reaching out to EdgeAccel legal now; will update within 24 hours. If they require an addendum for sharing redacted SBOM, we'll draft a quick DSA.

chloe (eng-ml): Drafts ready by EOD tomorrow for review? I can do that.

tess (partnerships): That would be awesome. If marketplace asks for an expedited review call, I'm available Tue/Wed mornings. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
